notes.subject: ktoret
notes.rationale: והקטרת em i samting bilong kaap long paia bilong givim gutpela smel — mi holim nem Hibru 'ktoret', i no 'smok' nating

notes.subject: במתכנתה
notes.rationale: matkonet — tok bilong 'ol mak bilong skelim', em i stap long Stat 30 tasol (30:32, 30:37)

notes.subject: singeltaim na plantaim
notes.rationale: Hibru i senis: תעשה (yu, singel) long stat, תעשו לכם (yupela) namel, לך (yu) long pinis — Tok Pisin i holim olgeta

translation: Na ktoret bilong yu wokim wantaim ⟨i⟩ ol mak bilong skelim bilong en — yupela no ken wokim wanpela bilong yupela yet; em i ken kamap holi bilong yu long Yahwe.

tokens.gloss: wantaim ol mak bilong skelim bilong en
